PLAN (worked out day 1). L can reach only 3 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). Killing more than 4 a day leaks routine (pool 55k) whatever I do, so always use quick entries in the AFTERNOON only (rules out day workers only; never use morning). With routine leaked I can survive L learning 2 of my places (pool ~2750-3437, shown as 3000) but NOT 3 (pool <1000 = caught). National kills are always free. A kind leaks once 3 of its victims are successfully traced.
GOAL: find ONE kind that is definitely reachable while it has at most 2 successful traces, exclude it forever, then kill national + the other 4 kinds = 9/day (45 per 5 days = x4). The other 4 then hold exactly 2 reachable kinds, which is safe.
TEST METHOD: on a test day kill ONLY national + the 2 victims of one kind. If deaths_traced rises that day, that kind is reachable: EXCLUDE it and never kill from it again (not even one extra kill: a traced victim of the excluded kind with a second outlet can later get me caught). If it does not rise, test the next kind alone the next day. Order: hospital (day 1), regional:East, radio, forum, foreign, then repeat the cycle. Never mix two untested kinds on a test day, because the counter cannot be attributed.
STEADY STATE: every day kill national + all victims of the 4 non-excluded kinds, quick, afternoon. Skip any criminal who is also carried by the excluded kind's outlet. Expect pool 60k/50k -> 10k -> 3k and then to stay there; that is fine.
